Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Clinical Operations Department does at Worldwide

Embark on a fulfilling Clinical Operations career as you leave a lasting impact on patients’ lives. Join Worldwide Clinical Trials for an unparalleled CRO experience, where you can drive extraordinary scientific breakthroughs and contribute to the very heart of every successful clinical trial.

What you will do

Working alongside brilliant minds across a variety of therapeutic areas, you will have the chance to collaborate closely with top-tier colleagues from diverse backgrounds and specialties. Our commitment to advancing clinical research is cultivated in a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with our hands-on leadership and dedicated team members working together to innovate and solve complex challenges for our customers.

Responsible for leading the delivery of clinical study site management activities through the co-ordination of a team of Clinical staff within a geographic region. Responsible for ensuring site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, site management and study close-out activities for studies in accordance with the with study protocol and study plan and Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Ensures overall quality and timeliness of Clinical deliverables for assigned programs and/or region.
Tasks may include but are not limited to:
Collaborate with Project Management to set site management targets/monitoring strategy and ensure compliance with project goals and Worldwide processes
Provide leadership and direction to clinical site management team members from study start through to closure
Serve as Site Management (SM) primary point of contact and representative for clinical monitoring and site activities within the project, including, but not limited to:

Primary SM Sponsor contact

Investigator and Bid Defense Meeting

Internal and External study team calls
Project specific Audits / Inspections
Manage monitoring deliverables to achieve study budget and identify Out of Scope Activities
Customize study-specific SM Quality Management Documents, e.g. the Clinical Monitoring Plans (CMP)
Oversee compliance to the CMP, including site visits, outstanding trip reports and visit follow up letters
Review protocol deviations and visit action items to ensure that activities are conducted according to the CMP.
Provide CRAs training all clinical aspects of the study with support from Project Management, Medical Monitoring and Sponsor as needed
Participate in the development and implementation of patient recruitment strategy in countries and sites assigned. Lead the tracking of recruitment and revision of site-specific recruitment plans as needed to ensure enrollment stays on target
Drive efforts to improve the quality of site data and address any identified needs with action plans. Review data metrics to ensure data integrity and quality
Track/measure SM deliverables to identify trends. Provide and monitor regular analytics through various project tracking systems such as project financial performance reports, study metrics and trending; resource allocation to project tasks, time recognition and other systems as needed
Oversee TMF (Trial Management File) compliance of site management documents, ensuring that QC review is on target and TMF is inspection ready
Formulate regional monitoring strategy and accountable for forecasting of site visits with CRA team in line with CMP to ensure staffing needs are met and any identified backlog is appropriately addressed
Review/finalize trip reports according to Worldwide SOPs and expectations
May perform site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and/or close out site visits as needed
Provide a key role in problem solving and first line issue escalation regarding monitoring and site issues, providing proposed solutions to the project management team and sponsor as needed
Proactively identify and mitigate risks
May represent site management as primary contact on projects
Conduct co-visits where required to ensure quality of site, the CRA work and study procedures.

What you will bring to the role

Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills in English + Portuguese (preferred) .
Excellent planning and organizational skills with effective time management

Excellent presentation skills

Flexibility to change

Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks with enthusiasm
Ability to negotiate and influence with diplomacy in order to achieve results
Demonstrate initiative and problem-solving skills by offering solutions when obstacles are identified
Must be able to prioritize tasks with attention to detail, plan proactively, and accomplish goals using well-defined instructions and procedures with minimal supervision
Ability to lead and motivate a team remotely
Ability to provide experience and input into process initiatives and development relating to monitoring and site management activities
Strong customer focus, ability to interact professionally within a sponsor contact
Extensive understanding of clinical research principles and process
Strong understanding of FDA and /or EU Directive regulations, ICH Guidelines and local regulatory requirements
Experience in the study therapeutic indication/area
Thorough understanding of standard operating procedures
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office, eCRF, IVRS packages
Proficiency with IxRS, CTMS and EDC systems

Your experience

Four-year college curriculum or equivalent with a major concentration in biological, physical or health studies and a minimum experience of three years as a Senior Clinical Research Associate (or equivalent), OR
Two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training (nursing degree or equivalent life science degree preferred) and a minimum experience of five years as a Senior Clinical Research Associate, or minimum 6-month experience functioning as CTM/LCRA (or equivalent); supporting main CTM and coordinating clinical operations activities

Travel required

Valid current passport required

Driving license required

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

raw.description:
About the tech stack:

Figma • Figma Make • Codex • GitHub Copilot • ChatGPT • Claude / Claude Code • Design Systems • Advanced Prototyping • Product Analytics & Experimentation

About your tasks:

  • Own the end-to-end product design process for Retail Media products and customer experiences, from discovery and research through prototyping, delivery and continuous optimisation, translating customer needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints into intuitive and scalable experiences.
  • Shape Retail Media and digital commerce experiences across areas such as sponsored products, advertising placements, personalisation, recommendations, merchandising, search, campaign interactions and conversion optimisation, always balancing commercial value with customer trust and accessibility.
  • Drive outcome-oriented design, partnering with UX Research and Data to understand customer behaviour, define hypotheses and use experimentation, product KPIs and user insights to continuously improve experiences.
  • Bring cross-functional teams together through Product Discovery, Design Thinking workshops and collaborative ideation, partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, Brand and Data from initial concept through high-quality implementation.
  • Use modern AI-powered design workflows including Figma Make, Codex, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and similar technologies to accelerate ideation, prototyping, UX writing and design exploration, while contributing to our Design System and championing Human-Centered Design and WCAG standards.

About you:

  • You bring several years of Product Design experience within cross-functional teams, including professional experience with B2C digital products, ideally across e-commerce, marketplaces, Retail Media, AdTech, MarTech or digital commerce.
  • You have strong expertise in Figma, including Auto Layout, Variables, Components, Design Systems and advanced prototyping, alongside experience using AI-assisted tools to accelerate modern product design and development workflows.
  • You combine strong interaction and visual design, systems thinking and information architecture with experience in Product Discovery, experimentation, A/B testing and KPI-driven optimisation. Exposure to personalisation, recommendations, search, merchandising or conversion-focused products is particularly valuable.
  • You’re confident bringing together customer needs, accessibility, commercial objectives and technical feasibility, facilitating interdisciplinary discussions and working closely with engineers throughout the product lifecycle. You’re fluent in English

It would be great if you also bring:

  • Experience working in healthcare, another regulated digital industry, or a large-scale technology/digital product organisation.
  • Experience with accessibility standards, such as WCAG 2.2 and the European Accessibility Act.
  • Familiarity with analytics and experimentation platforms, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, Contentsquare, Optimizely or similar.
  • Experience working in agile product organisations with continuous discovery and delivery.
  • German language skills would be a strong advantage.

No experience in online pharmacy? No problem: we’ll help you become familiar with the domain.

About your benefits:

In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits.

  • Remote space: For our remote working employees we grant you 500,00 € to set up your office space from home. To create an environment for you and how you work best.
  • Mental Health: Get quick and professional help from psychologists of nilo if you feel overwhelmed in private or professional life. Anonymous and free of charge.
  • Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
  • Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.
  • Employee discount: You get a 10 % employee discount on all over the counter, beauty and personal care products in our online store & 20 % discount on nu3.

While this is a remote position based in Germany, it may require occasional on-site collaboration at our offices in Berlin or Cologne, depending on business and team requirements.

About Redcare Pharmacy:

As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About the role:

As our Senior Product Designer – Retail Media, you’ll shape customer-centric experiences across one of our strategic growth areas, designing products that create value for customers, advertisers and healthcare partners without compromising trust, transparency or accessibility.

Working within our multidisciplinary UX team, you’ll have end-to-end design ownership across customer-facing experiences, advertiser products and internal tools, helping define what responsible Retail Media looks like at the intersection of digital healthcare, e-commerce and AI-enabled product development.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced sourcing and supply chain leader to drive Broadband's Contract Manufacturing (CM) and New Product Introduction (NPI) sourcing strategy. This role will be instrumental in shaping supplier partnerships, enabling successful product launches, and supporting strategic business growth through a resilient and high-performing supply network.

We're looking for a commercially astute, strategic leader who can operate comfortably from the boardroom to the factory floor. You are equally passionate about building supplier partnerships, developing talent, solving complex business challenges, and delivering measurable business results. Most importantly, you thrive in an environment where innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement drive success.

What You'll Do

Lead Broadband's NPI and Contract Manufacturing sourcing activities.

Develop and execute sourcing strategies aligned with business priorities and long-range plans.

Drive supplier selection, qualification, governance, and performance improvement.

Partner with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Finance, PLM, and S&OP teams to support successful product launches and supply chain performance.

Lead commercial negotiations, contract management, and strategic supplier relationships.

Develop and mentor a high-performing sourcing team while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Strong supplier partnerships delivering improvements in cost, quality, delivery, and responsiveness.

Successful NPI execution and reliable supply chain performance.

Enhanced sourcing analytics, governance, and execution discipline.

A capable, engaged, and high-performing team.

What You'll Bring

Significant experience in Sourcing, Procurement, Contract Manufacturing, NPI, or Supply Chain Operations.

Proven success leading sourcing strategies and supplier relationships for complex products or manufacturing environments.

Strong commercial, analytical, and leadership skills.

Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive results through collaboration.

Qualifications & Skills

Required:

  • Degree or CIPS certification in supply chain, Engineering, Business, Operations, or related field.

  • Significant experience in Sourcing, Procurement, Contract Manufacturing, New Product Introduction, or Supply Chain Operations.

  • Proven experience leading sourcing strategies and supplier selection for complex manufactured products or technical product portfolios.

  • Strong understanding of contract manufacturing models, make-versus-buy analysis, supplier governance, and supply chain optimization.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage supplier performance across cost, quality, delivery, lead time, MOQ, and responsiveness metrics.

  • Strong commercial, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with PLM, Engineering, Quality, Operations, Finance, and S&OP teams.

  • Ability to lead, coach, and develop teams while driving accountability and performance.

Preferred:

  • Experience in Broadband, telecommunications, fiber optic products, connectivity, or related technology/manufacturing environments.

  • Prior experience building or transforming sourcing, NPI, or Contract Manufacturing operating models.

  • Experience with sourcing analytics, spend management, contract lifecycle management, and supplier performance dashboards.

  • Knowledge of cost modelling, should-cost analysis, total cost of ownership, and value engineering.

  • ERP, sourcing platform, or procurement systems experience.

We recognise that no candidate will meet every qualification or experience listed in this job description. If you are excited about this opportunity and believe your skills, experience, and leadership capabilities align with most of what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and we're interested in talented individuals who can bring fresh thinking, drive results, and continue to grow within the role.

At CommScope, we believe potential is just as important as experience. If you have a strong foundation in sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, or related disciplines and can demonstrate the ability to learn, lead, and make an impact, we would welcome the opportunity to hear from you.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to influence sourcing strategy, shape global manufacturing partnerships, and play a key role in bringing innovative broadband products to market. You'll work with senior leaders across the business, lead strategic initiatives, and make a visible impact on business performance while developing your career within a global technology organisation. This reflects the role's responsibility for sourcing strategy, supplier partnerships, cross-functional leadership, and long-range business priorities.

Why CommScope:

CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn. Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables game-changing discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere. With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.
If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at CommScope.

Job Description Summary



This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 30% travel.

The Director, Future Field Engagement Strategy – Metrics & Incentives shapes how success is measured and celebrated across Novartis’ evolving commercial organization. This role designs forward‑looking performance metrics and incentive frameworks that align with modern engagement models, emerging field roles, and enterprise priorities. By reinforcing the right behaviors and outcomes, this leader helps inspire field teams while driving sustainable customer impact, growth, and long‑term competitiveness.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect and lead future‑ready measurement frameworks that define how Customer Engagement and Go‑to‑Market success are assessed across the enterprise.
  • Translate complex, aggregated performance signals (e.g., claims, prescribing, payer, CRM insights) into clear, strategic measurement constructs.
  • Shape balanced scorecards that intentionally measure both outcomes and critical enterprise behaviors, bringing an outside‑in perspective in close partnership with Insights and Decision Science (IDS).
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership by delivering forward‑looking insights on performance trends, risks, and opportunities, alongside Insights and Decision Science.
  • Reimagine incentive compensation strategies to align with evolving field roles, customer archetypes, and modern engagement models.
  • Steward incentive frameworks in partnership with Incentive Compensation teams to ensure they are equitable, transparent, and meaningfully motivating.
  • Continuously evolve metrics and incentives to reflect market dynamics, transformation priorities, and real‑world field feedback, in collaboration with Insights and Decision Science.
  • Partner across Insights and Decision Science, Finance, Field Leadership, and field enablement teams to ensure performance frameworks remain grounded, agile, and operationally impactful.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required from 4-year college or university.
  • 10+ years’ experience in incentive design, performance management, or field operations strategy, within pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or similarly structured industries with large, geographically dispersed teams. We also welcome candidates from other complex environments such as medical devices, diagnostics, life sciences services, insurance, consumer health, or B2B sectors.
  • Deep expertise in incentive compensation strategy, customer engagement metrics, and the levers that drive field performance and motivation.
  • Proven ability to design and scale innovative, data‑driven models that connect enterprise insights with real‑world field execution.
  • Strong fluency in healthcare systems, including payer and provider dynamics, enterprise account management, and evolving technology trends.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and aligning cross‑functional stakeholders within complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights, narratives, and action plans.
  • Trusted collaborator and communicator, skilled at building relationships, facilitating alignment, and driving outcomes across functions, geographies, and field teams.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience working with enterprise incentive compensation platforms and advanced analytics tools, including applying these capabilities to go‑to‑market transformation, evolving engagement models, and new role architectures.
  • Background in consulting or high‑growth environments, with demonstrated success building scalable measurement and incentive constructs across global or multi‑market teams while maintaining fairness, comparability, and strategic coherence.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $185,500 and $344,500 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

Description

Wij zijn CX-fanaten, net zo gepassioneerd over onze klanten als hun fans. Daarom vertrouwen de meest geliefde merken ter wereld op ons. Achter de schittering van baanbrekende fintechs, technologische legendes en meer… daar vind je ons.


We zijn op zoek naar Nederlandstalige klantenservicemedewerkers voor ons Odido-project bij Transcom in Spanje, met een nieuwe startdatum op28-09-2026 of 19-10-2026Lijkt het jou wat om ons team te komen versterken?


Wat levert het JOU op!

  • Werkmodel:100% remote werken vanuit het Spaanse vasteland.

  • Salaris:€ 1.342,73 bruto per maand (parttime, 25 uur per week).

  • Bonus:Kan oplopen tot 15% van het maandsalaris.

  • Training:2 weken training, waar je alle vaardigheden opdoet die je nodig hebt.

  • Carrière:Doorgroeimogelijkheden (bijv. Teamleider of Trainer).

  • Teamgevoel:Samenwerking met Nederlandse collega’s.

  • Erkenning:Je komt te werken voor een internationaal bekroond bedrijf.

Kom bij Transcom werken als klantenservicemedewerker!

Als klantenservicemedewerker voor Odido Service & Tech beantwoord je vragen over mobiele telefonie, internet en tv, zoals:

  • Mobiele diensten:Hoe installeer ik mijn simkaart? Hoe krijg ik internet op mijn mobiel?

  • Thuisdiensten:Mijn internet is traag, wat nu? Hoe stel ik mijn tv-box in?

Je helpt klanten met hun vragen, maar sales is ook een erg belangrijk deel van je rol. Dankzij je commerciële inzicht weet je precies wanneer cross- of upselling waarde toevoegt — voor de klant én het resultaat.


Wat wij zoeken:

  • Talenkennis:Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (C2) en een goede basis in het Engels (B1).

  • Service & Sales:Je bent communicatief sterk, klantgericht en ziet het als een uitdaging om commerciële kansen te benutten.

  • Probleemoplossend:Je werkt proactief en helpt klanten op een efficiënte wijze.

  • Tech-savvy:Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met technologie en beschikt over goede computervaardigheden.

  • Werkvergunning:Je beschikt over het wettelijke recht om in Spanje te wonen en te werken en bent in het bezit van de benodigde geldige documentatie.


Werktijden & Flexibiliteit:

  • Openingstijden:Maandag t/m vrijdag (15:00 – 20:00).
  • Training: Mogelijkheid om fulltime training te volgen van 12:00 tot 20:00 uur.

  • Flexibiliteit:Je bent flexibel inzetbaar op basis van de werkdruk, met name tijdens avond.


Hoe het leven bij Transcom is!

Bij Transcom zijn we toegewijd aan klanten én elkaar. Elke dag begint iemand zijn/haar reis bij Transcom. Ze ontwikkelen potentieel tot waardevolle vaardigheden. Ze worden erkend voor inzet, teamgeest en steun aan anderen. Ze zetten zich in voor positieve verandering binnen teams.


Dat is wie we zijn. Hier geven we om elkaar en moedigen we elkaar aan. Je bent welkom, precies zoals je bent, vanaf dag één. En met de juiste mindset is er geen grens aan wat we samen kunnen bereiken.

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Unique opportunity for an RN with a multi-state license in good standing to work in a remote Care Manager role supporting our Medicaid members who are to be released from incarceration in Washington state. Your role is to provide education regarding disease management and identify any resources they are eligible to receive to make their transition back into the community successful.

  • Must have a multi-state (compact) RN license.
  • At least 2 years of experience working in some capacity in the justice system.
  • Hours are M – F, 8 AM – 5 PM Pacific Time – candidates MUST be willing to work in that time zone regardless of residency.

Job Summary

Provides support for care management/care coordination activities and collaborates with multidisciplinary team coordinating integrated delivery of member care across the continuum. Strives to ensure member progress toward desired outcomes and contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.

Essential Job Duties

• Completes comprehensive assessments of members per regulated timelines and determines who may qualify for care management based on clinical judgment, changes in member health or psychosocial wellness and triggers identified in assessments.
• Develops and implements care coordination plan in collaboration with member, caregiver, physician and/or other appropriate health care professionals and member support network to address member needs and goals.
• Conducts telephonic, face-to-face or home visits as required.
• Performs ongoing monitoring of care plan to evaluate effectiveness, document interventions and goal achievement, and suggest changes accordingly.
• Maintains ongoing member caseload for regular outreach and management.

description: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

raw.title: Financial Analyst - Accounting & Advisory
raw.excerpt: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.
raw.description:
About the Client

We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

The firm works with entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, accounting and bookkeeping, back-office administration, and project management. Its clients span a variety of industries, including healthcare, professional services, government, and other service-based businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for a Financial Analyst – Accounting & Advisory to support the financial reporting, analysis, and research that underpin the firm's strategic advisory work.

The role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, financial analysis, and advisory support. You’ll work across multiple client businesses, preparing and analyzing P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, monthly financial packs, and straightforward forecasts while ensuring the senior advisory team has accurate and well-structured financial information to work from.

This is not primarily a valuation or complex financial modeling role. Instead, you'll develop a strong understanding of the financial operations of different businesses and turn their numbers into useful insights and structured outputs that support strategic decision-making.

There may also be research, commercial analysis, and project work depending on the needs of each client. As you develop, there is an opportunity to become increasingly involved in the strategic advisory side of the business.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Bahamas working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports across multiple client accounts.

  • Prepare recurring monthly financial and management reporting packs using established templates and processes.

  • Review and organize financial information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, movements, discrepancies, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support the financial back-office requirements of non-finance businesses across different industries.

  • Maintain well-organized financial information and supporting documentation across client accounts.

  • Learn and work with client-specific accounting systems, processes, and proprietary software where required.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain straightforward financial forecasts and projections.

  • Support cash flow planning and other forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Analyze historical and current financial performance to help inform business decisions.

  • Assist with financial analysis relating to commercial credit, loan financing, and other business requirements where needed.

  • Translate financial data into clear and structured information for senior team members.

  • Flag unusual movements, inconsistencies, or areas that warrant further investigation.

The modeling requirements for this role are relatively straightforward. You won't be expected to build complex valuation or transaction models; the emphasis is on strong financial fundamentals, accurate reporting, practical forecasting, and understanding what the numbers mean for the business.

Strategic Advisory & Research Support

  • Prepare financial information and analysis used by senior team members in client-facing strategic advisory work.

  • Conduct business, financial, market, or industry research where required for client assignments.

  • Gather and structure information needed to support strategic recommendations.

  • Help turn financial and research findings into clear reports, presentations, and other client-facing materials.

  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis for different business challenges and opportunities.

  • Develop an understanding of each client's business model, operations, and commercial environment rather than looking at financial information in isolation.

Client & Project Support

  • Work across multiple client accounts and adapt to different industries, business models, and reporting requirements.

  • Support project coordination, documentation, and follow-up across advisory engagements.

  • Manage recurring deliverables and ensure financial information is prepared accurately and on time.

  • Assist with broader analytical and administrative requirements connected to client projects.

  • Take increasing ownership of client work as your understanding and capabilities develop.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Ideally 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, FP&A, management reporting, corporate services, or a similar finance-focused environment. However, practical capability is more important to us than a specific number of years.

  • Academic background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements and how they work together.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and analyzing financial reports and management information.

  • Comfortable preparing straightforward forecasts and financial projections.

  • Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and confidence working with financial data.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and relevant insights from financial information.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and recognize when issues need to be escalated.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in professional services, corporate consultancy, accounting, FP&A, or financial advisory.

  • Experience supporting multiple external client accounts.

  • Experience working with SMEs or service-based businesses.

  • Exposure to healthcare, medical, dental, government, or other professional-services clients.

  • Understanding of commercial lending, loan financing, or credit analysis.

  • Experience preparing management reports and financial projections.

  • Previous exposure to strategic advisory or consulting projects.

  • Experience conducting business, market, or industry research.

  • Experience managing or supporting financial back-office operations for non-finance businesses.

  • Experience working across multiple industries.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re someone who is strong with numbers but also interested in the business behind them.

You can confidently work with P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flows, prepare reliable financial reporting, maintain forecasts, and spot when something doesn’t look right. At the same time, you’re curious about why the numbers are moving and what they mean for the business.

You may come from accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, consulting, or even a more traditional financial analyst background. What matters most is that you're comfortable with the practical financial work involved and genuinely interested in supporting businesses across a range of financial and strategic challenges.

This could also be a good fit for someone with a more modeling- or transaction-oriented finance background who is looking to move into a role with less emphasis on complex modeling and transactions and greater exposure to ongoing business operations and strategic advisory.

You’re organized, adaptable, commercially curious, and comfortable switching between financial reporting, forecasting, research, and project work across different client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a reliable extension of the advisory team who can independently manage high-quality financial preparation and analysis across multiple clients.

You’ll progressively reduce the financial preparation required from senior team members by ensuring reports, financial packs, forecasts, research, and supporting information are accurate, well-structured, and ready for use in strategic discussions.

As your understanding of the clients and advisory work develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility across financial analysis, research, strategic advisory, and project support.

Why Join?

  • Gain exposure to the financial operations and strategic challenges of multiple businesses and industries.

  • Work closely with experienced professionals on real-world client advisory engagements.

  • Build experience beyond traditional accounting or financial reporting into research and strategic advisory.

  • Take meaningful ownership of client work rather than being limited to one narrow finance function.

  • Develop a broader understanding of how financial information supports business strategy and decision-making.

  • Opportunity to grow into greater advisory and project responsibilities over time.

  • Join a fully remote team with a long-term opportunity for professional development.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Practical Financial Assessment for Finalists

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The practical assessment will take place after the client interview stage and will only be completed by final shortlisted candidates.

Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.

About the role
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our B2B division and work on the experience our business partners go through from their very first step with us.

The B2B Lifecycle team owns partner onboarding and activation. In practice, that means taking a new partner by the hand and guiding them through a clear, seamless flow: submitting all the required documents, getting them reviewed and approved, and then activating the financial products they need, explained in plain, human language, so partners actually understand what they're getting and how to use it to the fullest. Beyond that, partners manage their own organizational structure inside the product, teams, roles, and access, and that experience is ours to design too.

It's a domain full of complexity: legal requirements, verification logic, multi-step approvals, product configuration. Your job is to make all of it feel simple.

What you will be doing

  • Design end-to-end onboarding and activation flows for business partners, from first entry to a fully activated, active account
  • Turn a document-heavy, regulated process into a clear, guided experience with transparent statuses, meaningful feedback, and no dead ends
  • Design the activation experience for our financial products, helping partners understand what's available to them, why it matters, and how to get value from it
  • Design tools that let partners manage their own structure inside the product, organizations, teams, roles, and permissions
  • Work closely with your Product Manager to understand business requirements, unpack the underlying problems, and translate them into design solutions that serve both business goals and partner needs
  • Collaborate with UX Researchers to validate assumptions with real partners, and with a UX Writer to make complex, formal content genuinely readable
  • Partner with engineering throughout delivery and own the quality of what ships to production

What you will need

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with meaningful time spent on complex, logic-heavy products
  • Strong systems thinking: you're comfortable with multi-step flows, edge cases, states, and rules, and you enjoy bringing order to them
  • Ability to simplify: you can take a dense, formal, regulated process and turn it into something a person can move through without help
  • Strong product thinking, you understand business context and partner needs equally well
  • A portfolio showing end-to-end ownership, from problem framing to polished, production-ready UI
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with product managers, researchers, writers, and engineers
  • High craft standards and real care for what reaches users
  • You know how to optimize your workflow with AI tools and use them to work faster and
Nice to have
  • Experience with B2B, SaaS, admin panels, or other professional-user products
  • Experience with fintech, KYC/verification flows, or other regulated domains
  • Experience designing roles, permissions, and multi-user account structures
  • Experience contributing to or working within a design system

Job Benefits

Why join
  • A meaty, high-complexity design challenge where simplification has visible, measurable impact
  • Direct influence on how business partners experience our company from day one
  • A strong cross-functional team, product, research, content, and engineering, all invested in quality
Relocation and Employment
We offer remote work from anywhere in the world (our schedule is based on Dubai time though) and are happy to work out an individual relocation plan for you.
Our employees have the opportunity to choose a country for registration: at the moment those are Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Poland, Spain.

What you can expect
  • We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
  • A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
  • You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
  • Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).

If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

raw.title: Senior Engineer
raw.excerpt: As a senior engineer, you'll work across a diverse software portfolio—improving UIs, adding optimization workflows, fixing C++ bugs, and building MCP servers for LLM integration—rather than being tied to one product.
raw.description:
As a senior engineer, you'll work across a diverse software portfolio—improving UIs, adding optimization workflows, fixing C++ bugs, and building MCP servers for LLM integration—rather than being tied to one product.

You will work across our software portfolio rather than on a single product. On any given week that might mean improving the UI of a simulation control tool, adding a new optimisation workflow, fixing a bug in a C++ codebase, or building an MCP server that exposes one of our tools to an LLM agent.

UI quality and AI-friendliness are both priorities here, and they reinforce each other. A well-designed tool with clear inputs, predictable behaviour, and informative feedback is easier for a scientist to use and easier for an LLM to drive reliably. You will think about both audiences. Part of your work will be making our existing tools usable by AI agents, designing tool interfaces that behave well when an LLM is at the controls, and building agent pipelines that integrate with our simulation workflows.

We also have new projects to start from scratch. As you build familiarity with the domain and demonstrate ownership, there is genuine opportunity to lead one of those projects end-to-end.

No prior background in simulation or optimisation is expected. The domain is learnable and we will support that process. What matters is that you are genuinely curious, pick things up quickly, and enjoy building tools that serious technical users depend on.

C++ Programming Language; BS in Computer Science or applicable experience; must be fluent in English.

Minimum 5-8 years experience in this type of role and preferably in the semi-conductor industry.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Silvaco, we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at 408.567.1000.

About Silvaco, Inc.

For over four decades, Silvaco, based in Silicon Valley, California and with global locations around the world has solved semiconductor design challenges by offering affordable and competitive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) software, EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software, proven design IP (intellectual property), and world class support to engineers and researchers across the globe. Silvaco solutions span from atoms to systems: starting with simulation of material behavior impacting semiconductor devices, to design and analysis of transistor circuits, and lastly providing IP blocks for systems-on-chip (SoC) designs. Our solutions are deployed in production flows across broad industry segments such as leading display companies, automotive OEM suppliers, and top Memory, 5G, and IoT (internet of things) providers.

In addition to leading deployment activities, the role includes supporting one of the Program Leads with PMO, including governance, management reporting and Steering Committee preparation.

Frame Conditions

  • Start: October 12, 2026
  • Location: Remote
  • Onsite: Very occasional travel to Basel, Switzerland, approximately once per quarter
  • Language: English – fluent
  • Contract: Freelance
  • Candidate location: Only candidates based in the EU or Switzerland can be considered for this assignment.

Tasks

  • Lead and coordinate deployment activities across countries and business units.
  • Plan and manage rollout activities, milestones, dependencies and deployment readiness.
  • Coordinate with global program teams, local deployment organizations, Business, IT and Product teams.
  • Drive business and organizational readiness for upcoming rollout waves.
  • Track and manage risks, issues, dependencies and required decisions.

  • Prepare management updates, decision papers and Steering Committee presentations.
  • Consolidate information across workstreams and translate complex project topics into concise management communication.

Requirements

  • Experience as a Deployment Lead, Rollout Lead, Project Manager and PMO within large international transformation programs.
  • Experience with global or multi-country deployments involving different business units and stakeholder groups.
  • Good understanding of deployment planning, readiness management, go-live preparation and stabilization.
  • Experience within Procurement, Demand-to-Pay, Source-to-Pay or related business processes is highly beneficial.
  • Experience within Supplier Onbaording
  • Experience with the rollout of business applications or additional solutions within a broader ERP transformation is an advantage.
  • Strong PMO and program coordination skills.
  • Experience preparing management reporting and Steering Committee presentations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Business, IT, global program teams and local organizations.
  • Structured, proactive and comfortable working independently in a complex international program environment.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.
  • Fluent English is required

raw.description:
At Haines, everything works better with the right people. We've spent over a century helping New Zealand organisations find and keep theirs, and we're serious about the work, without taking ourselves too seriously.

What we're looking for

We provide recruitment solutions to a wide range of clients, and right now we need someone to help us source international candidates for one of them. You'll use LinkedIn Recruiter and your own tenacity to identify, connect with, and qualify candidates interested in moving to NZ. We work with our clients to develop their story, so you'll have a clear message to attract the right people. We'll be targeting candidates in Australia, the UK and North America, so you'll need to make some calls outside NZ office hours.

This is a part-time role (20 hours/week), 12-month contract. You choose your hours. If you're keen to pick up more hours down the track, there's scope to add sourcing work for other clients in different sectors.

The role is fully remote. We'd prefer someone based in Auckland or Wellington so you can pop into our Auckland CBD or Petone offices now and then.

What you'll bring

  • Expertise sourcing international candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter

  • Curiosity and openness to learn about roles across different sectors

  • Tenacity to find candidates across a wide range of communities

  • Comfort calling candidates outside normal NZ hours (UK and North American time zones)

  • Well organised, self-motivated, and happy working from home

  • A preference for flexible, part-time contracting work

  • Based in Auckland or Wellington (so you can join us in the office sometimes)

What you'll get

You'll join a team that's great at what they do and even better at being good humans. We're flat and supportive, always up for a laugh, and always willing to lend a hand.

Our Wellington office sits across the road from Petone Beach, and our Auckland office in the CBD comes with a weekly grocery shop of snacks and breakfast goodies.

We believe in flexibility and in the value of being together with teams and clients, so you can shape a work-life that fits your life. We back working hard and recharging, with a fitness subsidy and two weeks of additional Haines leave on top of your usual four. Once you're up to speed, you'll also get the chance to work from home a couple of days a week.

If work-life fit matters to you, and you want to bring your best to a company that'll help you do it, let's talk.

These values define our identity and guide our approach to achieving success.

If you are passionate about advancing your career, forging genuine connections, and becoming part of a team committed to your success, join us!

Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented Real Estate Virtual Assistant (Admin) to support the day-to-day administrative and transaction needs of a busy real estate business. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, enjoys keeping systems organized, and takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks — from listing paperwork to client follow-ups.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Coordination: Manage listing and closing paperwork from contract to close, ensuring all documents, deadlines, and disclosures are complete and properly filed
  • Calendar & Scheduling Management: Coordinate showings, inspections, appraisals, and client meetings across agents' calendars, avoiding conflicts and sending timely reminders

  • Document & File Organization: Create, organize, and maintain digital files for contracts, disclosures, and compliance documents using cloud storage systems
  • Marketing Support: Assist with creating and scheduling social media posts, email campaigns, and flyers for active listings
  • Reporting: Prepare weekly or monthly reports on pipeline status, closed transactions, and marketing performance for the broker/team lead

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Real Estate, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Experience: At least 2-3 years of experience as a Virtual Assistant or Administrative Assistant supporting a offshore client focusing on ﻿real estate.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with MLS platforms, CRM tools (e.g., Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, Chime, or similar), transaction management software (e.g., Dotloop, SkySlope, or DocuSign), Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office, and basic familiarity with project management or scheduling tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, Calendly)
  • Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, excellent time management, ability to multitask across multiple listings/transactions, proactive communication, and comfort working independently with minimal supervision
  • Language: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

What We Offer

  • Health & group life Insurance
  • Paid time off and birthday leave

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Provide periodic technical advisory oversight to ensure the long-term sustainability and performance of a mission-driven early childhood education application.

Organization:Confidential client in the non-profit/education sector; the name will be shared with shortlisted candidates before the client interview
Location:Remote - open to candidates in Lebanon, Jordan, or the wider MENA region (with strong Arabic/English fluency)
Role Type: Fixed term | Consultant-contractor | Part-time (~7 working days over 10 months)
Reports to: Head of Education, Lebanon

The opportunity

Our client is an international organization using theatre and play to support mental health and drive social justice across the Levant. They are seeking a Mobile and Web Application Support Consultant to provide technical oversight of their proprietary digital application, which transforms early childhood teaching and learning through play. In this role, you will act as a technical advisor rather than a developer, collaborating with the contracted software development company to guide maintenance priorities, assess vendor performance against contractual commitments, and help deliver strategic recommendations for the app’s long-term health and scalability.

About the organization

Our client is an award-winning NGO that has reached over 213,000 people in the last decade, winning recognition including the Digital Innovation of the Year prize at the 2025 PIEoneer Awards. The current focus is on ensuring their trilingual educational app—a bank of songs, games, and classroom management techniques for teachers of 3-8 year olds—continues to function efficiently for the least-resourced schools it serves..

What you will do

  • Periodically review the application’s overall functionality, performance, and stability to advise the client on its technical health without conducting continuous monitoring.
  • Act as a technical advisor in dealings with the external software development company, advising on their performance against contractual maintenance and support commitments.
  • Participate in periodic coordination meetings with the developer to guide discussions on technical priorities and issue resolution.
  • Advise on forward-looking maintenance plans and provide strategic recommendations on technical decisions related to the app’s long-term sustainability.
  • Prepare periodic advisory notes summarizing findings, vendor performance, and high-level guidance on whether delivered fixes meet expectations.

What you bring

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate with external software development vendors and oversee application support processes, shown through5–7 years of experience in software quality assurance, application support, or technical project coordination.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience working specifically with mobile applications and knowledge of software testing methodologies and bug tracking tools.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills to clearly articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Fluency in both English and Arabic.

Helpful, but not essential

  • Prior experience working within the NGO sector or on educational technology projects.
  • Familiarity with the specific tech stack used by the contracted software development company.
  • Experience in regional digital inclusion or early childhood education initiatives.

How the engagement works

Contracting party You will contract directly with Apricot, which will manage contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. Day to day, you will work with the client's education team and report to the Head of Education in Lebanon. For this consultant engagement, your work will be based on the agreed scope and deliverables, totaling approximately 7 working days spread over 10 months (2026-2027). You are expected to provide your own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity, and follow required security controls. Planned check-ins are scheduled for month 1 and month 3 to see how the engagement is working and help address any issues.

About Apricot
Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

raw.description:
Du kannst Menschen begeistern, hast ein Gespür für gute Beratung und möchtest mit dem Verkauf hochwertiger Häuser richtig durchstarten?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Die Poll Massivhaus GmbH steht für individuell geplante Massivhäuser, hochwertige Bauqualität und persönliche Betreuung von der ersten Idee bis zur Schlüsselübergabe. Als inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen sind wir regional verwurzelt und verbinden die Erfahrung eines etablierten Bauunternehmens mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und persönlichem Engagement.

Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebs suchen wir einen selbstständigen Vertriebsmitarbeiter / Handelsvertreter (m/w/d), der unsere individuellen Massivhäuser mit Leidenschaft und Überzeugung verkauft.

Aufgaben

Aus Wohnträumen echte Bauprojekte machen

Du begleitest unsere Interessenten auf dem Weg zum eigenen Zuhause – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Dabei bist du nicht einfach Verkäufer, sondern persönlicher Ansprechpartner und Berater unserer Bauherren.

Das erwartet dich:

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden und baust deinen eigenen Kundenstamm kontinuierlich aus
  • Du berätst Interessenten individuell zu unseren Massivhäusern und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung
  • Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, Hausbesichtigungen und Verkaufstermine durch
  • Du begleitest deine Kunden vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Beauftragung
  • Du erstellst Angebote, verfolgst diese konsequent nach und führst Verhandlungen
  • Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst daraus konkrete Baukonzepte
  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und pflegst dein Netzwerk
  • Du repräsentierst Poll Massivhaus bei Messen, Veranstaltungen und regionalen Vertriebsterminen
  • Du beobachtest den regionalen Markt und erschließt neue Vertriebs- und Kundenpotenziale

Qualifikation

Wir suchen keinen klassischen „Messeverkäufer“, sondern einen Vertriebler mit Persönlichkeit, Eigenantrieb und Abschlussstärke.

Du passt zu uns, wenn du:

  • bereits Erfahrung im Vertrieb gesammelt hast – idealerweise in der Bau-, Immobilien- oder Finanzbranche
  • Spaß daran hast, Menschen persönlich zu beraten und für ein Produkt zu begeistern
  • sicher, sympathisch und verbindlich auftrittst
  • ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und ihre individuellen Wünsche hast
  • Verhandlungen souverän führst und den Abschluss nicht scheust
  • selbstständig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich arbeitest
  • unternehmerisch denkst und deinen Erfolg selbst in die Hand nehmen möchtest
  • über ein gutes regionales Netzwerk verfügst oder bereit bist, dir eines aufzubauen
  • mobil bist und einen Führerschein der Klasse B besitzt

Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil, aber für uns nicht entscheidend. Viel wichtiger sind deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Persönlichkeit und dein Wille, erfolgreich zu sein.

Benefits

Dein Erfolg ist unser gemeinsamer Erfolg.

Bei Poll Massivhaus erwartet dich kein anonymer Konzern, sondern ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit kurzen Wegen, persönlichem Austausch und einem starken Team im Rücken.

  • Attraktives und leistungsorientiertes Provisionsmodell
  • Hohe Verdienstmöglichkeiten bei erfolgreichen Abschlüssen
  • Freie und flexible Zeiteinteilung als selbstständiger Handelsvertreter
  • Ein hochwertiges und beratungsintensives Produkt, hinter dem du stehen kannst
  • Individuelle Massivhäuser statt Häuser „von der Stange“
  • Qualifizierte Unterstützung durch unser erfahrenes Backoffice
  • Unterstützung bei Planung, Kalkulation und Angebotserstellung
  • Moderne Vertriebs- und Arbeitsmittel
  • Professionelle Unterlagen und hochwertige Präsentationsmaterialien
  • Persönliche Einarbeitung und fachliche Unterstützung
  • Zugang zu einem starken regionalen Netzwerk und spannenden Bauprojekten
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Austausch mit unserem Team
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit einem familiengeführten Unternehmen mit Zukunft

Deine Chance bei Poll Massivhaus

Du möchtest nicht einfach irgendein Produkt verkaufen, sondern Menschen bei einer der wichtigsten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens begleiten?

Du möchtest eigenständig arbeiten, deine Kunden selbst betreuen und dabei von attraktiven Verdienstmöglichkeiten profitieren?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Werde Teil der Poll Gruppe und baue gemeinsam mit uns die Häuser, die Menschen wirklich wollen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

raw.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering to lead a large, multidisciplinary engineering team building and operating AI-powered analytics products used by customers around the world.

In this role, you will lead a remote team of 10+ engineers across Australia, spanning backend, frontend, full-stack, data science, and platform engineering. Your team will own customer-facing product capabilities as well as the services and infrastructure required to make them reliable, secure, scalable, and performant.

You will partner closely with Product Management, UX Design, Technical Program Management, senior technical leads, architects, and engineering leaders to translate product and technology strategy into meaningful customer and business outcomes.

This is a senior engineering leadership role. You will maintain enough technical depth to provide sound engineering judgment, review significant technical proposals, and help navigate critical architectural and operational decisions. However, your primary focus will be building strong teams, developing technical leaders, and delivering results through others rather than serving as the team's primary hands-on engineer.

A Day in Your Life Will Include

  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of 10+ engineers, including hiring, performance management, succession planning, and career development.
  • Build leadership capability among senior engineers and technical leads, creating strong and sustainable technical ownership across the team.
  • Partner with Product Management to shape product and technical strategy and translate priorities into clear roadmaps and execution plans.
  • Lead delivery across complex, cross-functional dependencies while identifying systemic execution gaps and improving transparency, predictability, and delivery effectiveness.
  • Guide architectural consistency and review significant technical proposals across backend services, frontend experiences, data systems, and cloud infrastructure in partnership with senior engineers and architects.
  • Own operational outcomes across service reliability, scalability, performance, security, cost optimization, observability, incident learning, and technical debt reduction.
  • Champion the effective use of AI-assisted and agentic development practices throughout the software development lifecycle while maintaining strong standards for engineering ownership, testing, review, security, and quality.
  • Communicate progress, risks, technical context, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

What You'll Need

  • 10+ years of experience owning and delivering mission-critical software platforms, core systems, or complex SaaS products.
  • Demonstrated success as an engineering manager, delivering outcomes beyond a single team or across a complex technical domain.
  • Strong experience with distributed systems and leading teams responsible for scalable cloud services, production infrastructure, and customer-facing software.
  • Strong engineering judgment across architecture, system design, service boundaries, data flows, performance, reliability, security, and operational trade-offs.
  • Experience improving engineering quality through automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident management, secure development practices, and disciplined technical debt management.
  • A strong track record of coaching engineers at different career levels, developing technical leaders, and delivering results through others.
  • Proven ability to influence product and engineering strategy and align teams across Product, Design, Architecture, Platform, SRE, InfoSec, and Engineering.
  • Experience navigating ambiguity, organizational change, competing priorities, and incomplete information while maintaining clarity, focus, and team engagement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical, product, customer-facing, and executive audiences.

Our Technology Environment

Alteryx's technology stack includes:

  • Backend: Kotlin, Python, Java, C#, TypeScript
  • Databases: PostgreSQL and other relational data technologies
  • Messaging & Streaming: RabbitMQ, Kafka
  • Cloud: Azure, GCP, AWS
  • Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible
  • CI/CD & Observability: GitLab CI/CD, Datadog, and related tooling.

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We're looking for someone who has worked with comparable modern technologies and can apply strong engineering judgment within a complex SaaS environment.

Bonus Points

  • Demonstrated experience applying agentic or AI-assisted development practices across the software development lifecycle, including human oversight, evaluation, testing, security, and governance at scale.
  • Experience developing AI-powered products, agentic applications, LLM integrations, agent frameworks, or AI platform capabilities.
  • Experience building data or analytics products, particularly within business intelligence, data platforms, decision intelligence, or adjacent industries.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for operating and modernizing microservices, Kubernetes-based platforms, infrastructure as code, or multiple deployment models.
  • Experience mentoring peer managers or contributing to broader engineering leadership practices beyond direct reporting lines.

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.
