raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Level 3 AWS Cloud Engineer to join an Infrastructure Services team supporting fast-paced, cloud-focused customer environments. This role is ideal for a hands-on cloud professional with strong AWS expertise and experience designing, implementing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure.

You will work extensively with Infrastructure as Code, containerisation, serverless technologies, cloud security, monitoring, and CI/CD, while collaborating with DevOps, software engineering, and security teams to deliver robust production-grade solutions.

About the Client

You will be working with an established Australian technology services organisation that provides infrastructure and cloud solutions to a range of customers. The organisation focuses on delivering secure, reliable, and scalable technology environments while helping clients modernise and optimise their cloud infrastructure.

The team promotes technical excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, providing cloud engineers with the opportunity to work across modern AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.

Ideal Profile

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, or a related role.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across AWS services including EC2, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, and IAM.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud services.
  • Proven experience designing and managing production-grade cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with Terraform preferred.
  • Understanding of IaC best practices including version control, modularisation, reusability, and automated provisioning.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation.
  • Strong Git and GitHub workflow experience.

Containers & CI/CD

  • Experience managing containerised applications using ECS and/or Kubernetes.
  • Kubernetes experience with EKS, AKS, or self-managed clusters is highly desirable.
  • Experience collaborating with development teams to implement CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and/or GitLab CI.

Monitoring, Security & Databases

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and Azure Monitor.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, encryption, and network security.
  • Working knowledge of databases and SQL.
  • Understanding of cloud compliance and organisational security standards.

Personal Attributes

  • Self-motivated with a strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Collaborative approach with a willingness to share knowledge.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for delivering reliable cloud solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator Associate, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator are highly desirable.

Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, deploy, manage, and maintain cloud-based solutions primarily across AWS, with additional exposure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Build highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments.
  • Manage and optimise AWS infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, databases, serverless, and identity services.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to stakeholders on cloud infrastructure initiatives.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
  • Apply best practices for version control, modularisation, reusability, and maintainability across IaC solutions.
  • Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve infrastructure deployment and operational efficiency.

Containers & CI/CD

  • Deploy, manage, and optimise ECS and Kubernetes environments supporting containerised applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to design and implement effective CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support deployment automation and improve the reliability and consistency of software delivery processes.
  • Troubleshoot container and deployment-related issues across production environments.

Monitoring, Performance & Cost Optimisation

  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability.
  • Monitor cloud infrastructure performance and proactively identify potential issues.
  • Optimise cloud resource utilisation to improve cost efficiency and application performance.
  • Investigate incidents and implement appropriate improvements to maintain service reliability.

Security & Collaboration

  • Apply cloud security best practices across IAM policies, encryption, networking, and infrastructure configuration.
  • Ensure cloud environments align with relevant organisational and industry compliance standards.
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external DevOps, software engineering, and security teams.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and industry practices to continuously improve infrastructure services.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace
🌐 Internet allowance to keep you connected
💪 Gym & wellness allowance to stay fit and balanced
🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

We are currently seeking a Corporate M&A Lawyer to support Axiom clients across a broad range of sectors and corporate transactional matters. In this role, you will provide practical, commercially focused legal advice on mergers, acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, reorganisations, joint ventures and private equity investments, working closely with legal, finance, corporate development and business stakeholders across the full transaction lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Advise on corporate transactions including mergers, acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, reorganisations, joint ventures, and private equity investments, supporting execution across the full transaction lifecycle.
  • Lead on transaction delivery, including structuring, due diligence, risk assessment, and execution, with a focus on hands-on deal experience rather than purely advisory work.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate key transaction documentation (SPAs, shareholders’ agreements, disclosure letters, NDAs, ancillary documents) and advise on warranties, indemnities, and deal mechanics.
  • Provide support on corporate governance and company secretarial matters, including board processes, shareholder arrangements, and regulatory compliance (experience with entity rationalisations and reorganisations desirable).

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Eligible to practice as a lawyer in the UK with strong corporate experience gained in private practice or in-house environment's.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on complex corporate transactions (mergers, acquisitions, disposals, sales, restructurings, reorganisations), with a focus on execution and deal delivery.
  • Experience or exposure to corporate governance, company secretarial matters, and entity rationalisation projects desirable.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to provide practical, business-focused legal advice and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

You will advance our AWS ecosystem by driving our AWS CDK library and AWS Config Rules, enabling automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and a world-class developer experience for teams modernizing on Amazon Web Services. In this high-impact role, you will help define the future of Mutual of Omaha's technology platform used by internal I/S teams, business partners, and ultimately our customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary - Engineer II or III: $125,000 - $145,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.
  • 401k plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create innovative cloud solutions by designing and automating infrastructure using AWS CDK, TypeScript, and APIs - bringing ideas to life with Infrastructure as Code.
  • Partner with teams across the organization to uncover challenges, accelerate delivery, and make the developer experience seamless through modern self-service tools.
  • Apply engineering excellence to solve complex infrastructure problems - driving automation, self-healing capabilities, and reusable components that scale.
  • Lead lifecycle automation for distributed cloud platforms, ensuring smooth configuration, deployment, and monitoring for a stable, secure environment.
  • Build and optimize secure cloud networks, including load balancers, firewalls, and VPN connectivity, to keep our systems resilient and reliable.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Production TypeScript Expertise: 5+ years of software development experience, with a heavy emphasis on TypeScript (including advanced types, interface design, and asynchronous patterns).
  • Production AWS CDK Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience authoring, deploying, and debugging infrastructure explicitly using AWS CDK v2 in TypeScript. Experience must include writing custom L3 constructs with proper scoping and lifecycle controls.
  • Advanced IaC and State Management: Strong experience managing complex infrastructure as code deployments. This includes handling CDK aspects, escape hatches (modifying underlying L1 CloudFormation structures), cross-stack references, and structural deployment barriers.
  • Testing and CI/CD Pipelines: Experience implementing automated testing for CDK infrastructure using the aws-cdk-lib assertions assertions framework (e.g., Matchers, Template testing) and integrating CDK synthesis / deployment into automated pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline).
  • Operational Engineering: Strong background in cloud architectural design, testing, and operational support. Proven track record of building highly reusable, modular code components and implementing cloud governance or security compliance (such as CDK - nag).
  • You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • Ability to challenge the authenticity and effectiveness of team processes where opportunities for improvement exist.
  • Learn quickly when facing new problems and are a relentless and versatile learner, open to change.
  • Enjoy the challenge of unfamiliar tasks and ambiguity.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

If you have questions about your application or the hiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area at . Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

Stay Safe from Job ScamsMutual of Omaha only accepts applications from mutualofomaha.com/careers. Legitimate communications will come from '@mutualofomaha.com.' We never request sensitive information or extend job offers without conducting interviews. For more details, check our Hiring FAQs. Stay alert for scams and apply securely!

raw.description:
QSTA is een ondernemend platform binnen de foodbranche dat leveranciers, producenten en klanten in Retail, Industrie en Out of Home met elkaar verbindt. Wij ontwikkelen en realiseren onderscheidende private label-, merk- en foodconcepten en combineren daarbij commerciële slagkracht, marktkennis en operationele regie.

Naast productontwikkeling ondersteunen wij klanten met conceptontwikkeling, assortimentsvraagstukken, positionering en marktintroducties. Ook zetten wij digitale oplossingen in om samenwerking binnen de keten slimmer en efficiënter te maken.

QSTA maakt deel uit van de Bieze Food Group en de Wernsing Food Family. Hierdoor beschikken wij over een sterk nationaal en internationaal netwerk, brede marktkennis en de slagkracht om snel in te spelen op kansen in de markt. Ondernemerschap, korte lijnen en een no-nonsense mentaliteit vormen de basis van onze cultuur.

WAT GA JE DOEN ALS ONZE COMMERCIEEL MEDEWERKER BINNENDIENST?

  • Proactief opvolgen van nieuwe klanten na registratie en eerste bestelling;

  • Nabellen van orders om te toetsen of alles naar wens is verlopen;

  • Signaleren van commerciële kansen voor cross- en upselling;

  • Meedenken met klanten over assortimentsverbreding;

  • Vastleggen van klantfeedback in onze systemen;

  • Samenwerken met rayonmanagers en sales om kansen optimaal te benutten;

  • Bijdragen aan maximale klanttevredenheid en retentie.

WAT MAG JE VAN ONS VERWACHTEN?

  • Werken bij een innovatief, ambitieus en snelgroeiend foodplatform waar jouw ideeën ertoe doen;

  • Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om jouw rol zelf vorm te geven;

  • Directe invloed op klanttevredenheid, commerciële groei en de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie;

  • Samenwerken in een energiek en betrokken team met korte lijnen en een informele werksfeer;

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen;

  • Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé;

  • Een competitief salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, prestaties en toegevoegde waarde.

Requirements

WAT VERWACHTEN WE VAN JOU ALS ONZE COMMERCIEEL MEDEWERKER BINNENDIENST?

Wij zoeken een commerciële en ondernemende professional, iemand die het volgende meebrengt:

OPLEIDING & ERVARING

  • Afgeronde mbo-4 of hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in een commerciële richting;

  • Ervaring in een commerciële binnendienst-, sales support- of customer service functie;

  • Ervaring binnen food, FMCG of Out-of-Home is een pré;

  • Ervaring met ERP- en/of CRM-systemen is een plus.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je bent commercieel, klantgericht en communicatief sterk;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, proactief en houdt overzicht;

  • Je krijgt energie van samenwerken in een dynamische omgeving;

  • Affiniteit met food en de Out-of-Home markt.

MEER INFORMATIE OF DIRECT SOLLICITEREN?

Voor meer informatie over deze vacature en andere mogelijkheden kun je contact opnemen met onze HR-afdeling via .

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij werken uitsluitend samen met bureaus waarmee vooraf overeenstemming is bereikt over de voorwaarden.

As a Senior Application Developer, you’ll be at the forefront of designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge software solutions. Working closely with clients, business analysts, and cross-functional teams, you’ll ensure all solutions align with business strategies and IT architectural standards. From conceptualization to deployment, you’ll drive the full software development lifecycle, ensuring quality, scalability, and timely delivery.

What You’ll Do

We’re seeking a highly skilled and experienced developer who can operate in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. Key qualifications include:

Key Skills

  • Make an Impact: Lead major projects that span multiple business areas, contributing to innovative and strategic initiatives.

  • Embrace Innovation: Work with emerging technologies and platforms, driving continuous improvement and innovation in our solutions.
  • Collaborative Culture: Be part of a supportive and inclusive team that values collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with CommerceTools, ContentStack, or similar platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with React, including state management libraries like Redux or Context API.
  • Strong expertise in Microsoft development ecosystem.
  • Experience troubleshooting and optimizing complex systems for performance.
  • Knowledge of branching and merging strategies for version control.

Ready to Lead and Innovate? Apply Now! If you’re passionate about creating impactful technical solutions and mentoring the next generation of developers, we’d love to hear from you!

Bachelor’s degree in Programming/Systems or Computer Science or other related field. Or equivalent work experience. Typically requires 8 or more years of application programming and analysis experience.

Has a broad level of understanding surrounding information systems and application architecture standards. Experience in leading projects. Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret complex problems or processes that span multiple business areas, identify and understand requirements and develop alternate solutions. Experience designing, developing and testing applications using proven or emerging technologies, in a variety of technologies and environments

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable and responsive web applications using React.js, ensuring a smooth and user-friendly experience across different platforms.
  • Build secure, scalable, and high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot, including the development and integration of RESTful APIs.
  • Design, develop, and optimize MongoDB databases and data models while ensuring application performance and reliability.
  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain applications across AWS and Azure cloud environments.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, follow DevOps practices, and automate application build, testing, and deployment processes.
  • Ensure code quality and security through unit testing, code reviews, SonarQube analysis, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, DevOps Engineers, Architects, and other cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Use modern development practices and tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude AI, Docker/Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code to improve development efficiency and application delivery.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack application development, preferably working on enterprise or cloud-based applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing modern web applications using React.js.
  • Strong hands-on backend development experience with Java and Spring Boot, including building, integrating, and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Strong working knowledge of MongoDB and experience designing and optimizing database structures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and Azure cloud services and deploying applications in cloud environments.
  • Good understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs, and distributed application development.
  • Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and deployment automation.
  • Experience using Git and SonarQube for source control, code quality, and static code analysis.
  • Understanding of application security, vulnerability remediation, and secure development practices.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments with strong collaboration and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and application deployment.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM Templates, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience using GitHub Copilot, Claude AI, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • AWS or Azure cloud certification is an added advantage.

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.

  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a premier client’s business while achieving significant personal and professional growth. As a senior member of our Sales organization, you will leverage your deep expertise, strategic acumen, and consultative-selling prowess to strengthen and expand a marquee client relationship. Medical Scientist

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serves as a Clinical Data Reviewer and identify any errors in data by performing data review per DRP and issuing/closing queries.
  • Performs ongoing review of clinical/medical aspects of the study participant data and documents (escalates to Syneos/client Clinical Scientist and/or Study Medical Director, as appropriate)
    • Examples include but not limited to: Patient eligibility, diagnosis, medical history and prior treatments, study drug administration, AE/SAE/AESI, con meds, IP dose titration and/or compliance, safety labs, efficacy assessments (only if specified), EOT, EOS, survival, coding, etc.
    • Issues clinical data queries and ensure timely follow up following site responses as to whether the queries are appropriately addressed, and updates in EDC done, if applicable, by either closing out the queries or re-querying, as applicable and with consultation with the clinical team as needed.
  • Communicates to Sponsor any data training needs or concerns for CRAs, sites, etc
  • Provides clinical data review project management status and is viewed as an expert in data clinical/medical review and cleaning.
  • Ensures data quality focus to audit readiness with Clinical Compliance and Systems Validation Compliance.
  • May assist in review and contribute to data capture requirements guidance in line with protocol and reporting requirements.
  • Monitors site data entry performance and provide sponsor study team information to assist in identifying root causes of data issues and implementing remedial actions.
  • Ensures timely follow-up and resolution of clinical data related compliance issues.
  • Continuously assess opportunities to improve efficiency of tasks and quality of data deliverables.
  • May contribute to EDC completion training.
    • May exceptionally participate in clinical data review meetings and/or prepare slides for meetings
  • May be involved in preparing or review material for and in exceptional cases may present in data dissemination meetings.
  • Will collaborate closely with several Syneos/client functions mainly Clinical Scientists, Study Medical Directors, Data Management and Clinical Operations to execute clinical data reviews and activities during study conduct, including prior to data cuts for snapshots, interim analysis, DSUR, IBs, regulatory requests, study site close-outs and final DBL.
  • May be involved in QC review of patient narratives.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Cybersecurity Pre-Sales Engineer – SD-WAN & Secure Networking

In this customer-facing technical role, you will work closely with account managers, channel partners, and customers to design, position, and demonstrate secure networking solutions spanning secure SD-WAN, Security Service Edge (SSE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and hybrid firewall architectures. You will help SLED organizations understand how integrated network and security platforms protect students, citizens, employees, applications, and data across distributed and hybrid environments.

This is a remote field-based role; however, candidates must be based in the Seattle, Washington area to support the assigned territory and customers.

What You'll Do

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

Senior Biostatistician (5–8 Years)

  • Review Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) in alignment with protocols and regulatory requirements.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  • Run structured evaluation cycles (accuracy, error analysis, iteration)

  • Analyze outputs from real usage (logs, SQLite data, structured results)

  • Experience shipping at least one production-grade mobile app
  • Strong proficiency in React Native, Expo, and iOS ecosystem

  • Experience working with APIs and local databases (SQLite or similar)

  • Experience or formal training with LLMs and prompt engineering
  • Clear and proactive communication
  • Availability for full-time (or near full-time) internship
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to analyze results and iterate systematically

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The M&A Senior Lead will play a critical role in supporting HBX Group's inorganic growth agenda through the identification, evaluation, negotiation and execution of acquisitions, strategic partnerships, divestments and other corporate development initiatives.

As a senior member of the Investor Relations & Corporate Development team, the role combines strategic thinking, financial expertise, commercial judgement and transaction leadership to create long-term value for the Group. The M&A Senior Lead will lead complex transactions from origination through closing while acting as a trusted adviser to senior leadership and partnering closely with Legal, Tax, Finance, Strategy and operational business teams.

Origination & Strategic Development

  • Support the development and execution of HBX Group's inorganic growth strategy.

  • Maintain a pipeline of opportunities and develop investment theses for potential transactions.
  • Conduct market, industry and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends and attractive sectors.

Transaction Leadership & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end execution of acquisitions, divestments and strategic projects from assessment through closing.
  • Manage valuation, financial modelling, due diligence and transaction structuring activities.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisers throughout the transaction process.
  • Drive negotiations and support transaction documentation and execution.

Strategic Analysis & Board Support

  • Develop high-quality financial analyses and investment recommendations.
  • Prepare presentations and briefing materials for Senior Management, Executive Committees and the Board.
  • Assess strategic fit, value creation potential and investment risks.
  • Support key corporate initiatives and strategic projects beyond M&A activities.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted partner across Finance, Legal, Tax, Treasury, Strategy and Commercial teams.
  • Act as a primary point of contact for external advisers including investment banks, consultants and professional services firms.
  • Build relationships across the organisation to facilitate effective decision-making and transaction execution.

Team Leadership

  • Review and challenge analytical outputs to ensure high quality standards.
  • Contribute to the development of team processes, tools and best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture.

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and financial modeling skills, including high proficiency in Excel, Powerpoint and valuation techniques.
  • Very strong stakeholder management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to craft clear, compelling narratives.
  • Advanced project management and organizational ability.
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen,
  • Fluency in business-level English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to thrive under challenging deadlines while maintaining a high attention to detail.
  • Team builder with right attitude and culture that creates a good working environment.
  • Hands on profile (not too hierarchical)

Leadership & Strategic Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and long-term value creation mindset.
  • Strong commercial acumen and business judgement.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Resilience and effectiveness under pressure.

Communication & Relationship Management

  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills.
  • Exceptional written communication and storytelling capability.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Ability to build credibility with senior leaders and external partners.

Experience:

  • 8–10+ years of experience within Investment Banking, Private Equity, Corporate Development, Transaction Services or a related strategic finance environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex M&A transactions from origination through completion.
  • Proven track record of developing financial models, valuations and investment recommendations.
  • Experience working directly with senior executives and Board-level stakeholders.

  • International and cross-border transaction experience preferred.

Qualifications

The role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, financial analysis, and advisory support. You’ll work across multiple client businesses, preparing and analyzing P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, monthly financial packs, and straightforward forecasts while ensuring the senior advisory team has accurate and well-structured financial information to work from.

This is not primarily a valuation or complex financial modeling role. Instead, you'll develop a strong understanding of the financial operations of different businesses and turn their numbers into useful insights and structured outputs that support strategic decision-making.

There may also be research, commercial analysis, and project work depending on the needs of each client. As you develop, there is an opportunity to become increasingly involved in the strategic advisory side of the business.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Bahamas working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports across multiple client accounts.

  • Prepare recurring monthly financial and management reporting packs using established templates and processes.

  • Review and organize financial information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, movements, discrepancies, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support the financial back-office requirements of non-finance businesses across different industries.

  • Maintain well-organized financial information and supporting documentation across client accounts.

  • Learn and work with client-specific accounting systems, processes, and proprietary software where required.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain straightforward financial forecasts and projections.

  • Support cash flow planning and other forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Analyze historical and current financial performance to help inform business decisions.

  • Assist with financial analysis relating to commercial credit, loan financing, and other business requirements where needed.

  • Translate financial data into clear and structured information for senior team members.

  • Flag unusual movements, inconsistencies, or areas that warrant further investigation.

The modeling requirements for this role are relatively straightforward. You won't be expected to build complex valuation or transaction models; the emphasis is on strong financial fundamentals, accurate reporting, practical forecasting, and understanding what the numbers mean for the business.

Strategic Advisory & Research Support

  • Prepare financial information and analysis used by senior team members in client-facing strategic advisory work.

  • Conduct business, financial, market, or industry research where required for client assignments.

  • Gather and structure information needed to support strategic recommendations.

  • Help turn financial and research findings into clear reports, presentations, and other client-facing materials.

  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis for different business challenges and opportunities.

  • Develop an understanding of each client's business model, operations, and commercial environment rather than looking at financial information in isolation.

Client & Project Support

  • Work across multiple client accounts and adapt to different industries, business models, and reporting requirements.

  • Support project coordination, documentation, and follow-up across advisory engagements.

  • Manage recurring deliverables and ensure financial information is prepared accurately and on time.

  • Assist with broader analytical and administrative requirements connected to client projects.

  • Take increasing ownership of client work as your understanding and capabilities develop.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Ideally 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, FP&A, management reporting, corporate services, or a similar finance-focused environment. However, practical capability is more important to us than a specific number of years.

  • Academic background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements and how they work together.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and analyzing financial reports and management information.

  • Comfortable preparing straightforward forecasts and financial projections.

  • Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and confidence working with financial data.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and relevant insights from financial information.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and recognize when issues need to be escalated.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in professional services, corporate consultancy, accounting, FP&A, or financial advisory.

  • Experience supporting multiple external client accounts.

  • Experience working with SMEs or service-based businesses.

  • Exposure to healthcare, medical, dental, government, or other professional-services clients.

  • Understanding of commercial lending, loan financing, or credit analysis.

  • Experience preparing management reports and financial projections.

  • Previous exposure to strategic advisory or consulting projects.

  • Experience conducting business, market, or industry research.

  • Experience managing or supporting financial back-office operations for non-finance businesses.

  • Experience working across multiple industries.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re someone who is strong with numbers but also interested in the business behind them.

You can confidently work with P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flows, prepare reliable financial reporting, maintain forecasts, and spot when something doesn’t look right. At the same time, you’re curious about why the numbers are moving and what they mean for the business.

You may come from accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, consulting, or even a more traditional financial analyst background. What matters most is that you're comfortable with the practical financial work involved and genuinely interested in supporting businesses across a range of financial and strategic challenges.

This could also be a good fit for someone with a more modeling- or transaction-oriented finance background who is looking to move into a role with less emphasis on complex modeling and transactions and greater exposure to ongoing business operations and strategic advisory.

You’re organized, adaptable, commercially curious, and comfortable switching between financial reporting, forecasting, research, and project work across different client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a reliable extension of the advisory team who can independently manage high-quality financial preparation and analysis across multiple clients.

You’ll progressively reduce the financial preparation required from senior team members by ensuring reports, financial packs, forecasts, research, and supporting information are accurate, well-structured, and ready for use in strategic discussions.

As your understanding of the clients and advisory work develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility across financial analysis, research, strategic advisory, and project support.

Why Join?

  • Gain exposure to the financial operations and strategic challenges of multiple businesses and industries.

  • Work closely with experienced professionals on real-world client advisory engagements.

  • Build experience beyond traditional accounting or financial reporting into research and strategic advisory.

  • Take meaningful ownership of client work rather than being limited to one narrow finance function.

  • Develop a broader understanding of how financial information supports business strategy and decision-making.

  • Opportunity to grow into greater advisory and project responsibilities over time.

  • Join a fully remote team with a long-term opportunity for professional development.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Practical Financial Assessment for Finalists

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The practical assessment will take place after the client interview stage and will only be completed by final shortlisted candidates.

raw.description:
Full Stack Engineer Python / FastAPI Next.js TDD Remote friendly

About Us

We automate end to end candidate compliance for education recruitment agencies using deterministic, AI powered workflows. We collect and validate documents, execute compliance rules, and produce a fully auditable clearance outcome for every candidate. We are early, moving fast, and building something technically interesting. Agentic compliance pipelines, rules engines, and document processing AI on top of a clean FastAPI

and Next.js stack.

The Role

You will own both sides of the stack. Backend heavy in practice, focused on compliance logic, agentic workflows, and third party integrations, but you will also ship the React and Next.js surfaces that compliance teams and candidates use every day. This is not a lite frontend, serious backend split. We care deeply about both. The admin dashboard and candidate portal need to be fast, clear, and polished.

What You Will Do

Backend
Build and maintain FastAPI services that power compliance checks, document validation, and third party integrations

Design and implement durable, auditable workflow logic with a strong focus on traceability

Integrate external APIs including DBS providers, professional registers, and identity verification services

Write high coverage tests first. TDD is not optional here, it is how we work

Own database schema design and query performance on Postgres

Frontend
Build the candidate portal and admin dashboard in Next.js with a component first approach

Implement clean, accessible user interfaces using shadcn ui and Tailwind, with opinionated defaults rather than custom CSS

Keep frontend data fetching patterns tight using React Query, typed API contracts, and clear state management

Ship features end to end. You spec, build, test, and deploy

AI Engineering
Build compliance agents that validate candidate data, cross reference records, and review documentation against regulatory requirements

Implement browser automation for access to external verification portals, including selector resilience, failure recovery, and evidence capture

Instrument LLM workflows with observability tooling including traces, evaluations, prompt regression tests, and scoring pipelines

Maintain prompt quality through structured evaluation workflows.

Broken prompts should fail CI

How We Work
Tests are written before or alongside implementation

Backend stack includes FastAPI, Postgres using Neon, and Temporal Cloud for durable workflows

Frontend stack includes Next.js, shadcn ui, and Tailwind

Pull requests are small, reviewed quickly, and merged to main frequently

We are not looking for someone who ticks every box. If you are strong on backend, care about code quality, and can build a solid frontend, we would like to talk.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For
Must have
Strong Python and FastAPI experience with a solid understanding of async and clean service design

Solid React and Next.js skills. You can build a good looking, functional UI without hand holding

Practises TDD. Red, green, refactor is your default loop

Comfortable with relational databases including schema design, migrations, and query optimisation

Experience with REST APIs and third party integrations

Browser automation using Playwright or similar tools, including scripting, evidence capture, and reliable selectors

Strong Git hygiene including meaningful commits, small pull requests, and constructive code reviews

Nice to have
Experience with workflow orchestration such as Temporal

Familiarity with regulated environments or compliance adjacent products

Experience with shadcn ui, Radix, or similar headless component libraries

Exposure to LLM powered document processing or agentic systems and frameworks such as LangChain or Mastra

Experience with LLM evaluation workflows including prompt regression testing, scoring pipelines, and observability tools such as Langfuse, Braintrust, or LangSmith

Agentic engineering experience including declarative specs, skills, subagents, AGENTS.md, and ADRs

Experience building B2B SaaS products including multi tenancy, tenant isolation, external APIs, webhooks, and data feeds

Magnopus is looking for a Senior Technical Artist with deep Unreal Engine expertise to join our UK team as a freelancer on an exciting ongoing project.

Working closely with our creative and art teams, you'll help deliver high-quality real-time content in Unreal Engine, with a particular focus on performance optimisation, materials, content pipelines and technical art workflows. You'll play a key role in helping the team achieve the required visual quality while ensuring content meets demanding real-time performance targets.

This is a 3-month freelance opportunity.

What you'll do

  • Help develop and optimise real-time environments and assets, from initial content through to polished, performant scenes.
  • Work directly within Unreal Engine to provide technical support and guidance to the art team, helping troubleshoot and resolve content and performance challenges.
  • Profile and optimise 3D content, materials and environments to meet required real-time performance metrics.
  • Create, profile and optimise materials in Unreal Engine, balancing visual quality with real-time performance requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve and optimise existing art and content pipelines, helping the wider team work more efficiently and consistently.
  • Build and work with Unreal's PCG graphs to support efficient content creation and procedural environment workflows.

What will help you succeed in this role

  • Proven experience as a Senior 3D Technical Artist, with a strong track record working in Unreal Engine.
  • Deep understanding of Unreal Engine material creation, profiling and optimisation.
  • Strong knowledge of real-time 3D performance optimisation, including LODs, asset optimisation, draw calls, shader/material performance and profiling workflows.
  • Experience working with PCG graphs and procedural content workflows in Unreal Engine.
  • Professional experience delivering real-time content for games, immersive experiences, virtual production or similar projects.
  • A strong artistic eye, with the ability to balance visual quality, composition and creative intent with technical and performance requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with an art team and provide practical technical guidance.

Even better if you also have

  • Experience optimising large-scale environments or complex real-time scenes.
  • Familiarity with standard DCC packages such as Maya, 3ds Max or Blender.
  • Experience with Substance Painter, Substance Designer or Photoshop.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine's Sequencer, cameras, lighting and environment workflows.
  • Experience working with PCG at scale.

About Magnopus

Magnopus is an experience-focused technology company founded by a team of Oscar-winning artists, designers and engineers from the worlds of film, games and immersive media.

We create experiences that bring together storytelling, creativity and technology in new ways — from immersive attractions and interactive installations to virtual production, spatial computing, AI-powered experiences and emerging technologies. Our work helps some of the world's most recognisable brands and organisations connect with audiences in ways that weren't previously possible.

We've built experiences for millions of people around the world and continue to explore what's possible at the intersection of creativity, technology and human connection.

Though we've delivered a lot of incredible work, here are just a few examples you can explore yourself:

Metallica: Music Experience in UEFN
Mission: ISS
Alo Moves XR
World of Fallout
Daft Punk Experience, Fortnite
The Wizard of Oz at Sphere

We're proud of the work we create, but we're equally proud of how we create it. Magnopus is built around collaboration, curiosity and respect. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we strive to create an environment where talented people can learn, grow and do some of the best work of their careers.

You'll join a multidisciplinary team of artists, designers, engineers, producers and technologists who specialise in bringing ambitious ideas to life. Studio work at Magnopus is varied, collaborative and often unlike anything you've worked on before, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects that push creative and technical boundaries.

Please be aware that, if you are selected for a position, you will be required to provide proof of your right to work in the UK in accordance with the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006. Role Title: QA Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging QA Engineers to contribute expertise in software quality evaluation for a customer's high-volume project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is open to specialists who have both strong QA backgrounds and prior paid experience with human data annotation, RLHF, model output evaluation, or rubric-based grading for AI training. Software QA experience alone, without a human-in-the-loop AI evaluation component, does not count toward this requirement.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and rate AI-generated technical outputs against defined quality criteria and rubrics, identifying answers that may appear correct but are actually inaccurate or incomplete.
  2. Design and assess comprehensive test cases for functional, regression, and edge-case scenarios, including negative and boundary tests.
  3. Review bug reports and test documentation to ensure issues are reproducible, documentation is complete, and severity is properly assessed.
  4. Identify, isolate, and document defects with precise reproduction steps and utilize structured tracking mechanisms.
  5. Provide detailed, actionable written feedback and annotations to support efficient resolution by developers without the need for clarification.
  6. Collaborate with project teams to refine evaluation guidelines and ensure continuous improvement of testing standards and methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Proven professional experience as a QA Engineer, SDET, Test Engineer, QA Analyst, or similar role in software quality assurance.
  2. Strong command of QA fundamentals, including test case design, bug tracking, regression testing, and both manual and automated testing strategies.
  3. Hands-on experience with automation frameworks and test management tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, Postman, Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or BrowserStack (or similar tools).
  4. Prior paid human data experience supporting AI training—such as annotation, labeling, RLHF, AI response evaluation, model evaluation, or rubric-based grading—is a firm project requirement.
  5. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  6. Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in written English, providing specific, actionable feedback (B2 level or above).
  7. No formal degree required—practical, demonstrable testing experience takes precedence.
  8. Reliable internet connection and readiness to begin promptly.

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for a highly organized and culturally agile Expansion Events Coordinator to drive the physical presence of our Expansion Team. In this role you will be the operational backbone for our international growth, serving as a critical partner to our Expansion Managers in each country.

You will play a pivotal role in the end-to-end execution of a diverse event portfolio, ranging from conferences, workshops, summits and brand sponsorships to large-scale international conferences. Notably, you will provide direct support for the department, ensuring these world-class gatherings are executed with precision.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Execution: Lead the coordination of international events from initial concept and booth design through to on-site execution and post-event reporting.

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between global venues, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.

  • Logistics & Operations: Master the "fine print" by managing complex calendars, scheduling cross-functional meetings, overseeing intricate travel, event logistics, Finance & Budget coordination.

  • Financial Oversight: Support the Expansion Team with budget reconciliation, expense tracking, and detailed performance reporting.

  • Internal Logistics: Manage calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate travel logistics.

  • Global Communication: Manage both internal and external communications, ensuring the brand voice is consistent across English and Spanish-speaking markets.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Event Management or Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality & Tourism Management

  • A willingness and availability to travel when required.

  • Experience: 5+ years of proven success in global corporate events or the professional event industry.

  • Linguistic Versatility: Native or full professional proficiency in English and Spanish is required. (Bonus points if you speak Italian).

  • Tech-Savviness: Advanced proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office, with the ability to quickly adopt new project management tools.

  • A solid grasp of budgeting, invoicing, and expense management.

  • Adaptability: A "no task too big or small" mindset, comfortable moving from high-level sponsorship strategy to the ground-level execution.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

As a Business Development Manager at Procivis, you will play a critical role in driving our new business growth across the EU region and beyond. Your focus will be on expanding our market presence in the EU with our cutting-edge digital identity and verifiable credentials solutions in the public sector. Proficiency in English is a must; any other European language is advantageous.

Why Procivis?

  • Impactful Work: Contribute and shape the world of digital trust with decentralized digital identities and credentials.

  • Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge digital identity products and protocols.

  • Expert Team: Access to a knowledgeable team specializing in decentralized digital identities and credential solutions.

  • Flexible Working Arrangements: Enjoy a hybrid work model with the flexibility of remote and onsite working.

  • Growth Opportunities: Strong growth prospects within the company, with high expectations for ownership and accountability.

  • Dynamic Environment: Thrive in a dynamic and entrepreneurial work atmosphere.

To do’s

As a Business Development Manager at Procivis, your key responsibilities will be focussed on:

  • Market Expansion: Develop and implement business development strategies to expand Procivis' market presence in the EU region in public sector.

  • Client Acquisition: Identify and secure new business relationships and opportunities within the public sector, including participation in public tenders.

  • Solution Sales: Present and sell our digital identity and credentials solutions to prospective clients, crafting customized proposals and delivering impactful presentations.

  • Tender Management: Take responsibility for tenders in your territory and lead the cross functional bid team. Define the winning strategy and align it with the leadership.

  • Partner Sales: Build and maintain strong partner network in order to leverage partners for consulting, implementation and operation of our technology solution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to ensure project delivery, customer satisfaction and market feedback on our offerings.

Requirements

  • Public sector Sales Track Record: You have 3+ years of experience in selling successfully complex software solutions to the public sector (ministries, government agencies) in the EU. You have a proven track record of winning public tenders.

  • Sales Experience: 5+ years of experience in business development or sales (direct and indirect with partners) within the software industry, in particular with a focus on new business.

  • IT Experience: Profound knowledge and experience in software solution selling for a software company, IT consultancy or IT system integrator.

  • Domain Affinity: A strong understanding of the digital identity industry (digital identity, IAM, SSI, Verifiable Credentials) or related IT-security space is a significant advantage and will allow you to get up to speed quickly.

  • Educational Background: Completed bachelor’s or master’s degree.

  • Language Skills: Fluent in English (written and verbal) + at least one European language.

raw.description:
Job Description:


We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

Job Summary:

The Director of Product for Applied Research Intelligence (ARI) is a senior product leader who brings the voice of the corporate R&D customer into the heart of Wiley's newest growth business. ARI turns the world's trusted scientific literature and data into decision-grade intelligence for research and development teams in sectors such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, life-sciences, and materials sciences. This role owns Wiley's outward-facing product strategy for that market, reporting to the VP of Product, Applied Research Intelligence. The Director will lead partnerships and the integration ecosystem, shape how ARI is positioned and adopted, and translate deep, first-hand understanding of how R&D scientists work into product direction, customer wins, and partnership investments. It is a builder's role within an established global organization: high autonomy, high external visibility, and significant opportunity to grow into broader product leadership as the business scales.

Job Responsibilities:

Scope and Dimensions

  • Operate as a senior product leader and a peer to commercial, partnership, and engineering leaders across ARI and the wider AI & Data Analytics organization, leading through influence across functions.

  • Serve as a key external interface for the product with customers, design partners, and integration and technology partners, and represent ARI at industry and partner forums.

  • Shape product direction, partnership strategy, and commercial positioning as ARI establishes and grows its presence in the market.

  • Carry significant scope and autonomy, with the opportunity to build and lead an expanding product function as the business grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own ARI's outward-facing product strategy and value proposition. Define a clear, differentiated market point of view for ARI across pharma, biotech, life-sciences, and material sciences R frame how Wiley's trusted content and intelligence are positioned to customers and partners; demonstrate value through real customer engagement. Result: ARI is recognized as a market-leading intelligence platform with a value proposition that is clear, differentiated, and proven with customers.

  • Lead the partnership and integration ecosystem. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize integration and technology partners across the R&D tool ecosystem; shape build/buy/partner decisions and own the partnership and integration roadmap in close alignment with engineering, product, and partnerships teams and prospective and current partners. Result: a prioritized partnership and integration roadmap, with ARI embedded in the R&D ecosystem and its capabilities extended through the right partners.

  • Drive early customer wins and adoption. Work hands-on with sales, services, and customers to secure early customers and pilots, and build a repeatable land-and-expand motion. Result: design-partner customers secured, with a repeatable, scalable commercial motion.

  • Be the voice of the corporate R&D customer. Bring first-hand understanding of R&D scientists' workflows into the team; translate customer and market insight into product, enrichment, and roadmap priorities; feed competitive intelligence back to product, data science, and engineering. Result: roadmap and enrichment priorities grounded in real R&D workflows, with the team operating with sharp market and competitive awareness.

  • Shape commercial pipeline through senior product influence. Provide expert product framing to high-value customer and partner conversations; move relationships from content licensing toward strategic intelligence partnership, and support premium positioning. Result: high-value opportunities won at strong economics, with conversations shifting from transactional licensing to strategic intelligence partnership.

  • Represent ARI externally with authority. Be a credible, senior face for the product with customers, partners, and at industry conferences and events, operating effectively at C-suite and equivalent levels. Result: trusted senior relationships established, with ARI visibly and authoritatively represented in the market.

  • Build and scale the product function. As the business grows, help build, shape, and lead an expanding product function, developing the team, ways of working, and product strategy. Result: a stronger, scalable product function and a durable product strategy that grows with the business.

Required Qualifications:

  • First-hand experience working within corporate R&D in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life-sciences organizations, on or alongside research teams, working with scientific data and intelligence, combined with a demonstrated product mindset.

  • A track record of generating insight and intelligence from scientific literature and data across the R&D value chain, for example early research, clinical development, real-world evidence, medical affairs, or scientific and competitive intelligence.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in senior product, data-science, or scientific-innovation leadership roles, including senior-level and zero-to-one/new-market work, taking products, tools, or decision systems from concept to launch as a hands-on builder and implementer, with direct, first-hand exposure to pharmaceutical or life-sciences R&D.

  • Hands-on experience implementing GenAI and retrieval-based (RAG) solutions in a scientific or R&D context, as a proven implementer who has shipped production tools, with working familiarity across knowledge graphs, agentic AI, and APIs/integrations.

  • Deep understanding of R&D scientists and their buyers, with the gravitas and credibility to hold authoritative conversations at senior and C-suite levels, internally and externally.

  • A trusted advisor and cross-functional integrator who connects R&D, data/IT, and commercial functions so that innovation shows up in real workflows and decisions.

  • Strong commercial instinct, with a track record of using product and market insight to shape deals, partnerships, and roadmap decisions.

  • A proactive, go-getter operating style, highly comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy in a scale-up where the product and commercial motion is still being defined.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate across scientific, technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20%, primarily for customer and partner engagement, industry conferences, and team gatherings.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (PhD or MS) in a life-sciences, neuroscience, or related scientific discipline, ideally paired with strong technical or computational fluency; equivalent experience will be considered.

  • Depth in a therapeutic area where Wiley is strong, for example neuroscience and Alzheimer's, or oncology.

  • Experience with scientific and competitive intelligence, IP/patent-landscape analysis, or FAIR data practices.

  • Experience building, buying, or partnering to deliver scientific data or AI products; background in partnerships/business development, solutions, or technical pre-sales.

  • An established network across pharma/biotech R&D and the life-sciences data ecosystem.

  • Experience in a new business unit or scale-up where a product and commercial motion was established for the first time.


We power infinite possibilities.


For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.


Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact for assistance.

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. The range below represents Wiley's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.

When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered.

Salary Range:

145,200.00 USD to 212,800.00 USD
